definitions: Of, pertaining to, characteristic of, or happening or located in, a city or town; of, pertaining to, or characteristic of life in such a place, especially when contrasted with the countryside.
Living in a city or town.
An object, act or words believed to have magic power (usually carries a positive connotation).
The ability to persuade, delight or arouse admiration.
To seduce, persuade or fascinate someone or something.
To use a magical charm upon; to subdue, control, or summon by incantation or supernatural influence; to ensorcel or exert a magical effect on.
